content.text: Remove the bolts and remove the vacuum pipe and ground strap.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of distributor from cylinder head, including high-tension cord clip and plug boot

items: (a) Remove the high-tension cord clip bolt, leaving the wires attached to the clips.
(b) Disconnect the high tension cord by pulling on the plug boot.
(d) Remove the distributor from the cylinder head with the cap and wires.

content.description: Illustration showing location of various wire connectors to be disconnected from engine

content.text: 8. DISCONNECT COLD START INJECTOR FUEL HOSE FROM DELIVERY PIPE

content.description: Illustration showing air intake chamber with five bolts and two nuts locations, and EGR pipe nut location

items: (a) Remove the five bolts and two nuts.
(b) Loosen the nut of the EGR pipe.
(c) Remove the air intake chamber and gasket.

content.description: Illustration showing EFI wire harness location and removal from ECU through cowl panel

content.text: 10. DISCONNECT EFI WIRE HARNESS FROM ECU

items: (d) Pull out the EFI wire harness through the cowl panel.
